topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Past → Simple Present
title: Change Simple Past into Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Simple Past cümlesini Simple Present'e çevir:
• She worked yesterday. → She works every day.
Adımlar:
1. Fiilin yalın hâlini bul: worked → work, went → go, bought → buy, was → is
2. he/she/it ise -s/-es ekle: went → goes, watched → watches, studied → studies, had → has
3. I/you/we/they ile ek yok: they went → they go
be: was → am/is, were → are
explanation.tk:
Simple Past sözlemini Simple Present-e öwür:
• She worked yesterday. → She works every day.
Ädimler:
1. Işligiň esasy görnüşini tap: worked → work, went → go, bought → buy, was → is
2. he/she/it bolsa -s/-es goş: went → goes, watched → watches, studied → studies, had → has
3. I/you/we/they bilen goşulma ýok: they went → they go
be: was → am/is, were → are
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Simple Past в Simple Present:
• She worked yesterday. → She works every day.
Шаги:
1. Найди начальную форму: worked → work, went → go, bought → buy, was → is
2. Для he/she/it добавь -s/-es: went → goes, watched → watches, studied → studies, had → has
3. С I/you/we/they без окончания: they went → they go
be: was → am/is, were → are

examples.en: She went to school. → She goes to school.
They bought bread. → They buy bread.
He watched TV. → He watches TV.
I was tired. → I am tired.
We had a dog. → We have a dog.
My brother studied a lot. → My brother studies a lot.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Past → Simple Present – Negation
title: Negatives: Simple Past → Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz Simple Past cümlesini olumsuz Simple Present'e çevir:
• I didn't work. → I don't work.
• She didn't work. → She doesn't work.
• They didn't work. → They don't work.
Kural: didn't → don't (I/you/we/they) veya doesn't (he/she/it). Fiil yalın kalır.
be: wasn't → isn't / am not, weren't → aren't
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk Simple Past sözlemini ýokluk Simple Present-e öwür:
• I didn't work. → I don't work.
• She didn't work. → She doesn't work.
• They didn't work. → They don't work.
Düzgün: didn't → don't (I/you/we/they) ýa-da doesn't (he/she/it). Işlik esasy görnüşde galýar.
be: wasn't → isn't / am not, weren't → aren't
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй отрицание из Simple Past в Simple Present:
• I didn't work. → I don't work.
• She didn't work. → She doesn't work.
• They didn't work. → They don't work.
Правило: didn't → don't (I/you/we/they) или doesn't (he/she/it). Глагол в начальной форме.
be: wasn't → isn't / am not, weren't → aren't

examples.en: She didn't eat meat. → She doesn't eat meat.
We didn't watch TV. → We don't watch TV.
He wasn't at home. → He isn't at home.
They weren't ready. → They aren't ready.
I didn't like it. → I don't like it.
It didn't work. → It doesn't work.

exercises.question: My parents didn't smoke. → Simple Present:

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Past → Simple Present – Questions
title: Questions: Simple Past → Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Simple Past sorusunu Simple Present sorusuna çevir:
• Did you work? → Do you work?
• Did she work? → Does she work?
• Where did they live? → Where do they live?
Kural: Did → Do (I/you/we/they) veya Does (he/she/it). Fiil yalın kalır.
be: Was he...? → Is he...? Were they...? → Are they...?
explanation.tk:
Simple Past soragyny Simple Present soragyna öwür:
• Did you work? → Do you work?
• Did she work? → Does she work?
• Where did they live? → Where do they live?
Düzgün: Did → Do (I/you/we/they) ýa-da Does (he/she/it). Işlik esasy görnüşde galýar.
be: Was he...? → Is he...? Were they...? → Are they...?
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй вопрос из Simple Past в Simple Present:
• Did you work? → Do you work?
• Did she work? → Does she work?
• Where did they live? → Where do they live?
Правило: Did → Do (I/you/we/they) или Does (he/she/it). Глагол в начальной форме.
be: Was he...? → Is he...? Were they...? → Are they...?

examples.en: Did you like it? → Do you like it?
Did he play? → Does he play?
Where did they live? → Where do they live?
Was she at work? → Is she at work?
Were you busy? → Are you busy?
What did he say? → What does he say?

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Present Progressive
title: Change Simple Present into Present Progressive

explanation.tr:
Simple Present (genelde) cümlesini Present Progressive'e (şu an) çevir:
• She reads. → She is reading.
• They play. → They are playing.
Adımlar:
1. Özneye göre am/is/are ekle.
2. Fiildeki -s/-es'i kaldır ve -ing ekle: reads → reading, watches → watching, writes → writing, runs → running
explanation.tk:
Simple Present (adatça) sözlemini Present Progressive-e (häzir) öwür:
• She reads. → She is reading.
• They play. → They are playing.
Ädimler:
1. Eýä görä am/is/are goş.
2. Işlikdäki -s/-es-i aýyryp -ing goş: reads → reading, watches → watching, writes → writing, runs → running
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Simple Present (обычно) в Present Progressive (сейчас):
• She reads. → She is reading.
• They play. → They are playing.
Шаги:
1. Добавь am/is/are по подлежащему.
2. Убери -s/-es и добавь -ing: reads → reading, watches → watching, writes → writing, runs → running

examples.en: She reads. → She is reading.
They play. → They are playing.
I write. → I am writing.
He runs. → He is running.
We watch TV. → We are watching TV.
The cat sleeps. → The cat is sleeping.

exercises.question: He lies on the sofa. → Present Progressive:
options: He is lieing on the sofa.
He is lying on the sofa.
He is liing on the sofa.
He are lying on the sofa.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Present Progressive – Negation
title: Negatives: Simple Present → Present Progressive

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz Simple Present cümlesini olumsuz Present Progressive'e çevir:
• I don't work. → I'm not working.
• She doesn't work. → She isn't working.
• They don't work. → They aren't working.
Kural: don't → am not / aren't; doesn't → isn't. Fiile -ing eklenir.
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk Simple Present sözlemini ýokluk Present Progressive-e öwür:
• I don't work. → I'm not working.
• She doesn't work. → She isn't working.
• They don't work. → They aren't working.
Düzgün: don't → am not / aren't; doesn't → isn't. Işlige -ing goşulýar.
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй отрицание из Simple Present в Present Progressive:
• I don't work. → I'm not working.
• She doesn't work. → She isn't working.
• They don't work. → They aren't working.
Правило: don't → am not / aren't; doesn't → isn't. К глаголу добавляется -ing.

examples.en: I don't sleep. → I'm not sleeping.
He doesn't listen. → He isn't listening.
We don't eat. → We aren't eating.
It doesn't rain. → It isn't raining.
They don't run. → They aren't running.
She doesn't write. → She isn't writing.
